title: win11-bootstrap configuration
description: Selection and process-scoped network options for bootstrap.ps1. Confirmation bypass is intentionally unavailable in configuration files.

only.description: Select only these applications. The -Only command-line argument takes precedence when supplied.

skip.description: Skip these applications. Skip always wins over only.

proxyUri.description: Credential-free HTTP or HTTPS proxy used only by the bootstrapper process and its WinGet calls. User-info, query, and fragment components are rejected so secrets never enter native command lines.

seedDirectory.description: Directory containing user-supplied installers. A seed is never executed unless cataloged filename, SHA-256, and Authenticode checks all pass.
